description:
The apron says CERTIFIED SURVIVOR. It has said that for years. Nobody has ever asked Reg Naylor who certified him, which is fortunate, because the honest answer is a laminating machine in the Office of Permitted Suffering and a fee that has gone up twice since.

Reg would like you to have one too. Not out of kindness. Out of a slowly forming suspicion that if only one man in the Yards holds the certificate, the certificate is worthless, and Reg has been holding it for eleven years.

"Window's nine to eleven," he says. "Not nine to eleven when you get there. Nine to eleven when THEY say. Take money. Take more than you think."

He does not mention that the certificate certifies nothing, and neither does the office, and neither, afterwards, will you.
name: Certified Survivor

objectives.desc: Queue at the Office of Permitted Suffering.
emotes: {who} joins a queue that has the settled look of a queue that predates the building.
{who} is handed a form to establish eligibility for the form.

objectives.desc: Pay the lamination fee. It is not called a fee on the form.
emotes: {who} pays for a piece of plastic and receives a receipt for a different piece of plastic.

objectives.desc: Show Reg. He will want to hold it.
emotes: {who} lets Reg Naylor turn the card over twice in the light, saying nothing at all.
